Inclusion criteria:
  -  CES  [OR] and non- CES diagnosis was according to Trial of Org 10172 in Acute Stroke Treatment ﴾TOAST﴿ classification criteria
-  non -CES were selected to match patients with CES regarding age and vascular risk factors as a control group

right.raw_text: -  Patients with National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale ﴾NIHSS ﴿ score more than 5

left.raw_text: -  Adult  [AND] patients with their ages more than 18 year

Exclusion criteria:
  -  Lacunar stroke and transient ischemic attacks (TIAs)
  -  Haemorrhagic stroke

right.raw_text:
-  Neurological causes of acute focal cerebral dysfunction such as cerebral venous sinus thrombosis , head trauma, [OR]  infection, [OR]  and auto immune disorders
  -  Heart failure
  -  Liver failure
  -  Chronic renal disease
